text_block_list.text:
What they fought over against rivals in the
Triple Tiara was far more than just wins and losses on paper.
Admire Groove runs "for herself." Still in Love runs "for the one she loves."
"I absolutely cannot afford to lose to Still in Love, who runs on values entirely opposite to mine"—
Those overwhelming feelings of Admire Groove's began to have a more serious impact around the time of the summer training camp.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*... haah... haah!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why...?
How could I be out of breath from just this...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
I have no time to be taking it easy...!
I really don't...!

I showed her the video of her run.
Both her pace and form were an absolute mess.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
...!
What is this... This is—

"Normally, she wouldn't even need to review the footage.
She'd be able to correct herself before falling apart this much."
Her ability to analyze herself with pinpoint accuracy—the very skill that shaped who she is today—was failing to function.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: This can't be happening...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: (How... how utterly pathetic...!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(With running like this, I'll never beat her...!
Never—)

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"If dedicating my victory brings a smile
to 'that person's' face... I will risk everything."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
(I can't lose! Losing is not an option...!
Under no circumstances...! Especially not to her...!!)

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Uwaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaahhh!!

Accurately analyzing, reflecting, and improving upon herself.
This lifelong cycle since childhood had made her strong.

Yet unable to accurately analyze herself as she is now,
she cannot foster her own growth.

"If she runs in the Shuka Sho without proper training like this,
it might lead to a result she'll always regret."
For her, the Shuka Sho against Still in Love is the final battle wagering her very identity. And...

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"The timeframe is—until the end of the
Triple Tiara, just as she stated."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
"‘...Let us form a pact.
A fleeting contract—
until I settle things with her.’"

Back then, she kept everyone at a distance,
threatened by the emergence of a formidable rival.

To support her as she tried to fight all on her own, I offered contract terms that aligned with her wishes.
Namely, a limited-time contract until the Shuka Sho.

I think there was no other way back then.
Even so—I cannot look away from the reality closing in.

"The Shuka Sho will be the last race where I can support her.
Until then, at the very least, I must exhaust every single thing I can do."

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: *Gasp*... haah... haah...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Still... in... Love...!

Right now, Admire Groove is far too trapped
in her obsession with Still in Love.

Every time she's aware of them being close, every time they enter her sight.
Her tunnel vision worsening is a serious matter.
First, we have to alleviate this even a little bit...

It's an urgent priority to reduce contact between the two
during training. In other words, making it so
Admire Groove can train on her own.
choice_data_list: Top priority is securing a training environment...!

text_block_list.name: Cafeteria Lady
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... This stretch of beach is pretty long, you see.
Go a little further and it's packed with beachgoers...
Oh, but past the cape, I feel like I saw one long ago—
In this current environment, Admire Groove is too distracted by Still in Love to focus on training properly.
Relying on vague directions from the cafeteria lady, I wander around looking for a place suitable for training.
choice_data_list: I at least want to make sure she has no regrets...!

text_block_list.text:
Morning.
When I met up with Admire Groove at the entrance, she shot me a dubious look.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...You look quite sleepy, don't you?
I ended up getting back in the middle of the night, and it apparently showed on my face. I need to be more careful.
choice_data_list: More importantly, we're changing the training location!
More importantly, let's change the training location!

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: Change locations...?

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text:
A place like this... actually existed?
It's so quiet... I can only hear the sound of the waves...

She is the only Umamusume here.
No matter where one looks, Still in Love is nowhere to be seen.
A solitary world, just as she desired.
choice_data_list: During the day, we do strength training on the rocky terrain.
During the day, we do strength training on the rocky terrain.

text_block_list.text:
To run longer distances, we'll need to head back to the beach,
but we can just focus on early mornings and evenings when there are fewer people.
choice_data_list: First, ignore the noise and focus on training.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Right now, I'm grateful for this silence.

text_block_list.name: Admire Groove
text_block_list.text: ...Let us begin.
From then on, Admire Groove gradually regained her composure and was somehow able to train properly.
